en.title: Illegal food advertising data set
en.description: This dataset compiles the records of food advertising violations issued by the municipal health bureaus and the Food and Drug Administration. The information displayed is limited to the written document. However, this dataset may be subject to subsequent revisions, and does not necessarily indicate that the products in question are illegal. Please review with caution.
en.notes: The API documentation URL compliant with the OAS standard is: https://data.fda.gov.tw/opendata/exportDataList.do?methodopenDataApi&InfoId22

resources.description: This dataset consolidates the food violation advertising penalties issued by the various municipal health bureaus and their subordinate units. The displayed fields are limited to those recorded in the documents. However, this dataset may be subject to subsequent revisions and adjustments. It does not imply that the products of the subject of the penalty are illegal. Please review it carefully.
resources.fieldDesc: Violation Product Name、Name of non-compliant company or responsible person、The competent authority、Disposition date、Administrative Penalty Law、Publication date、Media category、Media coverage、Deal with the situation
resources.note: The URL for the API documentation that conforms to the OAS standard is: https://data.fda.gov.tw/opendata/exportDataList.do?methodopenDataApi&InfoId22

resources.description: This dataset compiles records of food advertising violations issued by the health bureaus of various counties and cities. The information column is limited to the documents issued, but the dataset may be subject to subsequent revisions. It does not imply that the products of the disciplinary subjects are illegal. Please use caution when using this information for reference.
resources.fieldDesc: Violation Product Name、Name of non-compliant company or responsible person、The competent authority、Disposition date、Administrative Penalty Law、Publication date、Media category、Media coverage、Deal with the situation
resources.note: The API documentation URL compliant with OAS standards: https://data.fda.gov.tw/opendata/exportDataList.do?methodopenDataApi&InfoId22

resources.description: This dataset compiles the records of advertising penalties for food violations issued by the health bureaus of various counties and cities. The displayed fields are limited to the written notices, and the dataset may be subject to subsequent revisions. This does not imply that the products subject to penalties are illegal. Please use it carefully.
resources.fieldDesc: Violation Product Name、Name of non-compliant company or responsible person、The competent authority、Disposition date、Administrative Penalty Law、Publication date、Media category、Media coverage、Deal with the situation
